---
title: "Computational Thinking makes sense of Mathematics"
subtitle: "Open materials for teaching university mathematics with programming"
toc: false
---

CTM is an Erasmus+ partnership of six European universities (2024–2026). Together
they bring computational thinking and Python programming into first-year university
mathematics. Everything the project produced is openly available. This page
collects it in one place.

::: {.ctm-figures}
<div><b>6</b>partner universities</div>
<div><b>50+</b>projects in the pool</div>
<div><b>3</b>open courses + workshops</div>
<div><b>10</b>software repositories</div>
:::
